blocks.en: The ReLEAF production case in one place: engineered B. subtilis under green light, a contained perfusion reactor that makes a plant protectant at the edge of the field, the regulatory and market consequences, and what binds when the unit is replicated.

生物製造

blocks.en: ReLEAF develops an on-site biomanufacturing system that uses engineered Bacillus subtilis and a 400 mL perfusion bioreactor to produce plant-protective proteins beside the plants that need it.
blocks.text: ReLEAF develops an on-site biomanufacturing system that uses engineered Bacillus subtilis and a 400 mL perfusion bioreactor to produce plant-protective proteins beside the plants that need it.
blocks.zh: ReLEAF 發展一套就地生物製造系統，以工程化的 Bacillus subtilis 與一台 400 mL 灌流式生物反應器，在需要它的植物旁邊生產具植物保護功能的蛋白質。

blocks.en: Our biomanufacturing approach combines controlled protein production, continuous culture, product recovery, and cell containment in one system. The culture circulates on the lumen side of the hollow-fiber membrane, while soluble protein crosses to the shell side product stream. We successfully demonstrated a 102.4-hour reactor run, during which OD600 increased from 0.8 to 3.8 while transmembrane pressure remained within about ±0.1 bar. Quantitative permeate concentration and green-light-dependent PcpcG2 output remain to be established.

blocks.en: ReLEAF works on agricultural biologicals: plant-protective molecules that support crops under the heat, drought and salinity they cannot escape.

blocks.en: Such a molecule also has to be produced reliably, delivered when the stress arrives, and kept affordable and contained; those barriers usually decide whether it reaches a field. blocks.en: ACC deaminase is the protectant every bench result on this wiki was produced with. It interrupts the ethylene route shown in the lower panel: abiotic stress raises ACC, ACC oxidase converts ACC into ethylene, and ethylene reduces nodulation and growth. ACC deaminase competes for the same substrate and degrades ACC first, lowering ethylene while leaving the rest of the plant's stress signaling intact.

blocks.zh: ACC 去胺酶是本 wiki 上每一項實驗檯結果所使用的保護劑。它打斷下方圖示的乙烯路徑：非生物逆境使 ACC 升高，ACC 氧化酶把 ACC 轉成乙烯，而乙烯會抑制根瘤形成與生長。ACC 去胺酶競爭同一個受質，搶先分解 ACC，壓低乙烯，同時不動到植物其餘的逆境訊息傳遞。

blocks.en: The production chain above, figure (a), shows how ReLEAF produces and delivers the protectant, beginning with the detection of plant stress and ending with its release from the bioreactor. As shown in diagram (b), abiotic stress increases 1-aminocyclopropane-1-carboxylic acid (ACC), normally converted into ethylene by ACC oxidase. ACC deaminase instead breaks down ACC before this conversion can occur, helping reduce the negative effects of excess ethylene on plant growth. A stage-by-stage breakdown of the production chain and the status of each module can be found on Results.

用於生物生產的光遺傳學

blocks.en: Rather than engineering B. subtilis to produce protectants continuously, we wanted production to turn on only when it was needed. ReLEAF therefore uses the green-light-responsive CcaSR optogenetic system. When the system receives a green-light signal, CcaS senses the light and activates CcaR (Castillo-Hair et al., 2019), which then turns on expression of the selected protectant: ACC deaminase, LEA14 or BoPEP4.
blocks.text: Rather than engineering B. subtilis to produce protectants continuously, we wanted production to turn on only when it was needed. ReLEAF therefore uses the green-light-responsive CcaSR optogenetic system. When the system receives a green-light signal, CcaS senses the light and activates CcaR (Castillo-Hair et al., 2019), which then turns on expression of the selected protectant: ACC deaminase, LEA14 or BoPEP4.
blocks.zh: 我們並不想把 B. subtilis 改造成持續生產保護劑，而是希望只有在需要時才開啟生產。因此 ReLEAF 採用對綠光反應的 CcaSR 光遺傳系統。當系統收到綠光訊號，CcaS 感測到光並活化 CcaR（Castillo-Hair et al., 2019），接著開啟所選保護劑的表現：ACC 去胺酶、LEA14 或 BoPEP4。

blocks.en: Our construct is built from four main parts: ho1:pcyA supplies the chromophore needed for light sensing, CcaS‑m3 acts as the sensor, CcaR acts as the response regulator, and P<sub>cpcG2</sub>-veg controls expression of the downstream protectant. ACC deaminase, LEA14 or BoPEP4 can then be placed in this last output position. As controls, we also built constitutive versions of the protectant constructs, allowing us to test whether a negative result comes from the protectant itself or from the light-responsive system.

blocks.zh: 我們的構築由四個主要部分組成：ho1:pcyA 提供光感測所需的發色團，CcaS-m3 作為感測器，CcaR 作為反應調節子，P<sub>cpcG2</sub>-veg 則控制下游保護劑的表現。ACC 去胺酶、LEA14 或 BoPEP4 都可以放進最後這個輸出位置。作為對照，我們也建了保護劑構築的組成型版本，好分辨陰性結果究竟來自保護劑本身，還是來自光反應系統。

blocks.en: Using light as the trigger gives us a simple way to connect biological production with our digital sensing system. Unlike chemical inducers such as IPTG, light does not need to be added to the culture, leaves no residue in the product stream, and does not create a recurring inducer cost for each batch. The bioreactor can therefore receive a signal electronically and activate production through an LED without opening the system.
blocks.text: Using light as the trigger gives us a simple way to connect biological production with our digital sensing system. Unlike chemical inducers such as IPTG, light does not need to be added to the culture, leaves no residue in the product stream, and does not create a recurring inducer cost for each batch. The bioreactor can therefore receive a signal electronically and activate production through an LED without opening the system.
blocks.zh: 用光當作觸發，讓我們能用很簡單的方式把生物生產接上數位感測系統。和 IPTG 這類化學誘導物不同，光不必加進菌液裡，不會在產物流中留下殘留，也不會讓每一批次都多一筆誘導物成本。因此生物反應器可以用電子方式收到訊號，透過 LED 啟動生產，完全不必打開系統。

blocks.en: Furthermore, optogenetic control addresses the growth–production tradeoff (Glick, 1995). Resources spent on recombinant protein are resources not spent on growth, so continuous expression taxes the chassis for the whole run. Light-responsive production lets cells build biomass first and switch to protectant only when conditions call for it.

blocks.zh: 此外，光遺傳控制也處理了生長與生產之間的取捨（Glick, 1995）。花在重組蛋白上的資源，就是沒花在生長上的資源，所以持續表現會讓宿主在整段運轉期間都背著負擔。由光決定的生產，讓細胞先長出菌體，等條件要求時再切換去做保護劑。

blocks.en: Before using optogenetics for production, we wanted to know whether the light conditions themselves affected bacterial growth. Across all six light arms on 19 September the growth rates were very similar (0.279 to 0.317 h<sup>−1</sup>) and fell within one standard error of each other. The strongest green-light condition also reached the highest final OD. This suggests that, under the conditions tested, green-light induction did not noticeably reduce biomass growth.

蛋白質工程、分泌與回收

blocks.en: The product is one of three proteins: ACC deaminase, which lowers stress-induced ethylene; LEA14, a late embryogenesis abundant protein that stabilizes other proteins under osmotic stress; and BoPEP4, a twenty-three residue elicitor peptide that signals drought through the PEPR1 receptor. Before any DNA was ordered, sequence analysis, structural modeling and targeted substitutions tested the candidates against two constraints at once: the receptor has to recognize the molecule, and Bacillus subtilis has to translate it, secrete it through the Sec pathway and leave it whole in a protease-rich supernatant.

Before any DNA was ordered, sequence analysis, structural modeling and targeted substitutions tested the candidates against two constraints at once: the receptor has to recognize the molecule, and Bacillus subtilis has to translate it, secrete it through the Sec pathway and leave it whole in a protease-rich supernatant.
blocks.zh: 產物是三種蛋白質之一：ACC 去胺酶，可降低逆境誘發的乙烯；LEA14，一種晚期胚胎發生豐富蛋白，能在滲透逆境下穩定其他蛋白質；以及 BoPEP4，一段二十三個胺基酸殘基的激發子胜肽，透過 PEPR1 受體傳遞乾旱訊號。在訂購任何 DNA 之前，序列分析、結構建模與定點置換就同時以兩項限制檢驗候選分子：受體必須認得這個分子，而 Bacillus subtilis 必須能轉譯它、經由 Sec 路徑分泌它，並且讓它在富含蛋白酶的上清液中保持完整。

blocks.en: Two of those results changed a construct. BoPEP4's uncharged GILIGS opening makes no receptor contact and is conserved nowhere, and removing residues 1 to 6 leaves the docking score flat. 生物反應器系統

blocks.en: The culture circulates through the lumen side of a hollow-fiber cartridge rated at 0.2 µm, sweeping along the fiber walls instead of through them, which is cross-flow. Whole cells stay in the loop, smaller soluble proteins cross into the shell side under the pressure difference across the membrane, the transmembrane pressure, and that shell-side permeate is what leaves the machine. One cartridge retains and recovers at once, so the process has no downstream train. Unlike a batch fermenter the cells are not harvested after each cycle: the culture stays in circulation while product is removed continuously, so one culture supports repeated production.
blocks.text: The culture circulates through the lumen side of a hollow-fiber cartridge rated at 0.2 µm, sweeping along the fiber walls instead of through them, which is cross-flow. Whole cells stay in the loop, smaller soluble proteins cross into the shell side under the pressure difference across the membrane, the transmembrane pressure, and that shell-side permeate is what leaves the machine. One cartridge retains and recovers at once, so the process has no downstream train. Unlike a batch fermenter the cells are not harvested after each cycle: the culture stays in circulation while product is removed continuously, so one culture supports repeated production.
blocks.zh: 菌液在孔徑規格 0.2 µm 的中空纖維匣管腔側循環，沿著纖維壁掃過而不是穿過它，這就是錯流。完整的細胞留在迴路中，較小的可溶性蛋白則在跨膜壓差下穿到殼側，而那股殼側透過液就是離開機器的東西。同一個匣同時完成留住與回收，所以這個製程沒有下游純化串列。與批次發酵槽不同，細胞不會在每個週期後被收走：菌液持續循環，產物則被不斷取出，因此一批培養可以支撐反覆的生產。

blocks.en: Two models have been tested against recorded runs. The forecast sets when the green light is switched on and for how long, and a person approves that. Green light and dissolved oxygen are tested separately and not yet joined to the live loop; the models so far run on recorded data after each run.

法規與生物安全

blocks.en: Farmers want to be able to say their crops are organic, and the bioreactor was built around that: the membrane keeps the engineered Bacillus subtilis in the culture loop, and only the protectant passes into the product stream.
blocks.text: Farmers want to be able to say their crops are organic, and the bioreactor was built around that: the membrane keeps the engineered Bacillus subtilis in the culture loop, and only the protectant passes into the product stream.
blocks.zh: 農友希望能說自己的作物是有機的，而這台生物反應器正是繞著這件事設計的：膜把工程化的 Bacillus subtilis 留在培養迴路內，只有保護劑會進入產物流。

blocks.en: Containment and recovery are the same unit operation here. No filtration or kill step sits between the culture and the product, so the membrane both recovers the protein and retains the organism, and a module failure affects the two together. Monitoring the membrane is therefore part of monitoring containment: pressure and flow are logged continuously, the microcontroller opens the pinch valve above 0.70 bar, and a droplet sensor beneath the rig checks for external leakage.

blocks.zh: 在這裡，圍阻與回收是同一個單元操作。培養液與產物之間沒有任何過濾或滅活步驟，所以膜同時回收蛋白質並留住菌體，而一次模組失效會同時影響兩者。因此監看膜就是監看圍阻：壓力與流量持續記錄，微控制器在超過 0.70 bar 時開啟夾管閥，裝置下方的液滴感測器則偵測外漏。

blocks.en: Lumen- and shell-side containment test. The lumen-side sample (a) produced colonies after plating, while no colonies were observed from the shell-side sample (b) after 24 hours at 37 °C. blocks.en: Cell-free, so it is classified by composition, intended function and product claim rather than by how it was made. In the EU a non-microbial product whose claimed function is improving tolerance to abiotic stress can fall under Regulation 2019/1009, PFC 6(B) plant biostimulant.

blocks.en: In Taiwan and the United States classification is less straightforward, depending on whether the product counts as supporting nutrient use, altering plant physiology or acting as a plant regulator, so we evaluate the biostimulant, biofertiliser and biopesticide routes separately for each protectant and each market.

blocks.en: Keeping the organism inside the machine gives the production strain and the agricultural product two independent regulatory paths, and that split applies across all three markets: containment rules for the engineered microorganism, and a separate plant-biostimulant or fertilizer route for the recovered output, decided by the claimed function of improving tolerance to abiotic stress.

blocks.en: Feasibility depends on whether the protectant a unit produces justifies the cost of running it. blocks.en: Capacity can be increased along one of two routes. Scale-up enlarges a single vessel, so every quantity that depends on a length scale has to be re-established at the new size: mass transfer (how fast a dissolved substance crosses from one phase into another), oxygen supply, heat removal, mixing time and membrane area per unit volume. Scale-out keeps the unit fixed and replicates it, so every module runs at conditions already characterized. ReLEAF scales out (AGC Biologics, n.d.).

blocks.en: We chose that route because tangential-flow filtration, the cross-flow arrangement described above, has a formal method for it, which is also why a hollow-fiber module was selected over a stirred tank with filtration on the side. Linear scale-up keeps every size-independent flow quantity constant, the wall shear rate above all, and increases only the channel count, with transmembrane pressure controlled so that the concentration at the membrane wall does not change; van Reis and colleagues (1997) report a 400-fold increase in scale carried this way without an intermediate pilot stage. Hollow fiber suits the method because a scale-down module has the same fiber length as an industrial one, so our module serves directly as the unit cell to be replicated.

blocks.en: We worked each requirement of one module through to eight, asking in each case whether the quantity binds. blocks.en: One change would reduce three of those four together. Running the recirculation pump on a duty cycle instead of continuously cuts the dominant electrical load, the cumulative shear exposure and the medium draw at once, and the reactor has margin for it: at the design flux it already delivers more medium per day than a week in the field could absorb, and the biology responds over hours. blocks.en: The membrane is therefore oversized for the duty by more than an order of magnitude, a consequence of selecting the module for its fiber geometry. Flux could be raised about 23-fold before fouling becomes limiting, still short of the roughly 60 LMH that cell-specific perfusion would require for a liter of culture (below), so on this module the membrane and the medium supply become limiting together. Two qualifications apply. Local flux is not uniform, so low-level fouling can occur below the nominal threshold and no operating point should be quoted as sitting exactly at J<sub>crit</sub> (van Reis & Zydney, 2007); and the model treats the feed as cells in water, whereas secreted protein, media components and cell debris each add resistance it does not account for.

blocks.zh: 也就是說，這張膜對這項任務超規了一個數量級以上，這是為了纖維幾何而選這個模組的後果。通量還可以提高約 23 倍才會讓積垢成為限制，但仍不到單細胞灌流速率對一公升培養液所需的約 60 LMH（見下），所以在這個模組上，膜與培養液供應是一起變成限制的。有兩點要但書。局部通量並不均勻，因此在名目門檻以下仍可能發生低度積垢，任何運轉點都不該被說成正好坐在 J<sub>crit</sub> 上（van Reis & Zydney, 2007）；再者，模型把進料視為水中的細胞，而分泌出的蛋白質、培養基成分與細胞碎片各自都會增加它沒有算進去的阻力。
單細胞灌流速率

blocks.en: The governing quantity is the cell-specific perfusion rate, the volume of medium delivered per cell per day. The chemostat washout inequality D < µ<sub>max</sub>, between the dilution rate and the maximum growth rate, does not apply, because a 0.2 µm membrane retains rods of 1 to 2 µm: permeate leaves and biomass does not, so the dilution rate can exceed the growth rate without washing the culture out.

blocks.zh: 關鍵的量是單細胞灌流速率，也就是每個細胞每天被供給的培養液體積。恆化器的沖洗不等式 D < µ<sub>max</sub>（稀釋率對最大生長速率）在這裡並不適用，因為 0.2 µm 的膜會留住 1 至 2 µm 的桿菌：透過液離開，菌體不離開，所以稀釋率可以超過生長速率而不會把菌液沖掉。

blocks.en: Modern perfusion practice sits between 0.02 and 0.5 nL per cell per day; at 2 LMH, with OD600 1.454 in 1 L and 10<sup>9</sup> cells per mL per OD unit, ours is 0.0007, about thirty times under the band, so the cells are fed very lean. The bottom of the band, 0.02, needs about 60 LMH, above the 46 LMH fouling threshold, and 0.05 needs about 150 LMH. The medium arithmetic agrees: at 2 LMH the module draws 0.67 mL/min, 0.96 L a day and about ten turnovers of the 100 mL loop; at 60 LMH it is about 29 L a day. For a bench run over a shift that is unremarkable; for a device left unattended in a field for a week, the medium needed to feed the cells conventionally is the binding constraint, and more membrane alone does not remove it.

氧氣、能源與死時間

blocks.en: Oxygen supply limits cell density before anything else does. At the carrying capacity of OD600 1.454, taking 0.4 g dry cell weight per liter per OD unit and a conservative uptake of 3 mmol g<sup>−1</sup> h<sup>−1</sup>, the culture consumes 1.74 mmol L<sup>−1</sup> h<sup>−1</sup> and requires a k<sub>L</sub>a of 12.5 h<sup>−1</sup>, modest for a sparged fermenter and demanding for a closed loop with no gas port. The dissolved inventory shows the constraint more clearly: a 100 mL loop held at 30% of saturation contains 0.006 mmol against a consumption of 0.174 mmol per hour, so an interruption exhausts it in about two minutes, and in just under seven from full saturation. Oxygen is a throughput quantity here, and cell density has to be capped at what the loop can transfer.

blocks.zh: 供氧比其他任何因素都更早限制細胞密度。在 OD600 1.454 的負載上限下，取每單位 OD 每公升 0.4 g 乾細胞重與保守的 3 mmol g<sup>−1</sup> h<sup>−1</sup> 攝取量，菌液消耗 1.74 mmol L<sup>−1</sup> h<sup>−1</sup>，需要 12.5 h<sup>−1</sup> 的 k<sub>L</sub>a——這對通氣發酵槽而言很平常，對一條沒有氣孔的封閉迴路卻很吃力。溶解態的存量更清楚地顯示這個限制：一條維持在飽和度 30% 的 100 mL 迴路只含 0.006 mmol，而每小時消耗 0.174 mmol，所以一次中斷約兩分鐘就會耗盡，從全飽和算起也不到七分鐘。氧氣在這裡是一個通量問題，細胞密度必須被壓在迴路傳得過去的程度。

blocks.en: Energy decides whether a unit can be deployed in a field at all. We sized the supply against Taiwan's worst-case winter peak-sun-hours of about three per day, not the annual average. At a 75% harvest efficiency from panel through battery to load, a 45 W panel returns 101 Wh per day against a draw of 72 to 192 Wh; at a mid-point draw of 5 W the balance supplies 0.84 of the requirement, and a 53 W panel would close it. That spread comes from one unmeasured quantity, the continuous draw of the recirculation pump, which a clamp-meter reading would resolve.

blocks.en: Loop dead time θ sums sensor sampling, controller cycle, LED ramp, the CcaSR activation half-time, secretion lag and pump transit, and the half-time of 105.1 ± 1.5 min (Castillo-Hair et al., 2019) dominates it. The system time constant τ is the shell exchange time, 150 minutes at 2 LMH and 15 minutes at 20 LMH, so θ/τ falls between 0.7 and 7.0: at the design flux the dead time is comparable to the time constant, and above it it dominates. Such a loop remains controllable but responds slowly, and raising the flux shortens τ and increases the ratio, so the delivery rate cannot be set on plant-response grounds alone.

blocks.zh: 迴路死時間 θ 是感測器取樣、控制器週期、LED 升光、CcaSR 活化半衰期、分泌延遲與幫浦輸送時間的總和，而 105.1 ± 1.5 分鐘的半衰期（Castillo-Hair et al., 2019）主導了它。系統時間常數 τ 是殼側換液時間，在 2 LMH 下為 150 分鐘，在 20 LMH 下為 15 分鐘，因此 θ/τ 落在 0.7 至 7.0 之間：在設計通量下死時間與時間常數相當，在它之上則由死時間主導。這樣的迴路仍然可控，但反應很慢，而提高通量會縮短 τ、拉高這個比值，所以輸送速率不能只按植物反應來設定。

blocks.en: The transmembrane pressure the method is supposed to keep constant is resolved only to ±10 kPa against an axial drop, the pressure lost along the length of a fiber, of 11.6 kPa at the pump floor (BP8G-AGA pressure transmitter, n.d.), so fouling has to be read from a trend, not a single reading. A 0 to 100 kPa sensor resolves ±1 kPa and is the cheapest upgrade available to this reactor (specification on Measurement).

blocks.en: Our own records give the module as both 150 cm² with eight fibers and 200 cm² with eleven, and the one place the arithmetic has been checked against the bench agrees with eleven. On 16 August 2026, in water at 22 °C, we ran eight pump settings, once with the module fitted and once with a jumper in its place, and fitted ΔP = aQ + bQ² through the origin to both, the module fit at R² 0.9954. At 263 mL/min the net module drop is 0.096 bar, 1.03 times the Hagen–Poiseuille prediction, the laminar pressure drop expected in open tubes, for eleven open fibers; a lumen weighed on 13 August gave 7.0 to 7.2 mL of holdup against a computed 3.74 mL. The shear table above uses eight fibers, so its values are the conservative, higher ones, while the membrane area, permeate and medium figures use the 200 cm² and eleven fibers that the bench check and the rig software's constants agree on. Bench calibration puts pump setting 10 at about 100 mL/min against the vendor floor of 230, and three calibrations across three days span 100 to 140, widening the usable shear window. The hydraulic fit is R1 on Digital Twin.

blocks.zh: 我們自己的紀錄把這個模組同時寫成 150 cm²、八根纖維，以及 200 cm²、十一根纖維，而唯一一處把算術拿去跟實驗檯對過的地方，站在十一根這一邊。2026 年 8 月 16 日，在 22 °C 的水中，我們跑了八個幫浦設定，一次裝上模組、一次以短路接頭取代，並對兩者以通過原點的 ΔP = aQ + bQ² 擬合，模組的擬合 R² 為 0.9954。在 263 mL/min 下模組的淨壓降為 0.096 bar，是十一根開放纖維的 Hagen–Poiseuille 預測值——也就是開放管中應有的層流壓降——的 1.03 倍；8 月 13 日秤出的管腔持液量為 7.0 至 7.2 mL，而計算值為 3.74 mL。上方的剪切表用的是八根纖維，所以它給的是較保守、偏高的數值；而膜面積、透過液與培養液的數字用的是 200 cm² 與十一根纖維，也就是實驗檯檢核與裝置軟體常數彼此一致的那一組。檯面校正把幫浦設定 10 定在約 100 mL/min，而廠商下限是 230，且三天內的三次校正落在 100 至 140 之間，把可用的剪切窗口拉得更寬。水力擬合是數位孿生的 R1。

attrs.zh: 西方墨點法的膜，有兩道分子量標記與四個樣品泳道，標示為 P1、P2、S、S，條帶只出現在兩個 S 泳道、位於 35 與 48 千道爾頓標記之間。

attrs.en: The bioreactor
attrs.zh: 生物反應器

attrs.en: System diagram of the perfusion bioreactor: culture vessel under a green LED, peristaltic pump, sampler, spectrophotometer, pressure sensor, hollow-fibre membrane, pinch valve, permeate reservoir with pH regulator, feeding a hydroponics system and a soil sprinkler line.
attrs.zh: 灌流式生物反應器的系統圖：綠光 LED 下的培養槽、蠕動幫浦、取樣器、分光光度計、壓力感測器、中空纖維膜、夾管閥，以及附 pH 調節的透過液儲槽，供應一套水耕系統與一條土耕噴灌管線。

attrs.en: The perfusion loop running on a shelf inside an incubator: culture bottle, peristaltic pump, hollow-fibre module and tubing, with a laptop beside it showing the live optical density trace.
attrs.zh: 培養箱層架上運轉中的灌流迴路：菌液瓶、蠕動幫浦、中空纖維模組與管路，旁邊一台筆電顯示即時的光密度曲線。

attrs.en: The digital twin
attrs.zh: 數位孿生

attrs.en: A laptop screen showing the Digital Twin dashboard during a run: optical density and pH charts, four pressure traces, membrane filtration values, data recording and pump controls.
attrs.zh: 運轉中的筆電畫面顯示數位孿生儀表板：光密度與 pH 圖表、四條壓力曲線、膜過濾數值、資料錄製與幫浦控制。

attrs.en: Regulation and biosafety
attrs.zh: 法規與生物安全

attrs.en: Two agar plates side by side: the lumen-side sample grows colonies, the shell-side sample is clear.
attrs.zh: 並排的兩塊瓊脂培養盤：管腔側樣品長出菌落，殼側樣品則乾淨無菌落。

attrs.en: A three-circle Venn diagram for the United States, the European Union and Taiwan. Each circle lists the rules for the bioreactor, the culture and the output; the overlaps list shared concepts such as engineered-microorganism biosafety and plant-biostimulant or fertiliser regulation. The centre reads: core claim, improves plant tolerance to abiotic stress; agricultural input rather than pesticide.
attrs.zh: 美國、歐盟與臺灣的三圓文氏圖。每個圓列出該地對生物反應器、培養物與產出的規範；交集處列出共通的概念，例如工程化微生物的生物安全，以及植物生物刺激素或肥料的法規。中央寫著：核心宣稱，改善植物對非生物逆境的耐受性；屬農業資材而非農藥。

attrs.en: Field Deployment
attrs.zh: 田間佈署

attrs.en: Students in ReLEAF shirts standing at the edge of a rice paddy, talking with a farmer who carries a harvesting basket.
attrs.zh: 穿著 ReLEAF 隊服的學生站在水田邊，與一位提著收穫竹籃的農友交談。

attrs.en: Chart positioning candidate markets against yield opportunity and regulatory difficulty.
attrs.zh: 將候選市場依產量機會與法規難度定位的圖表。

attrs.zh: 規模化

attrs.zh: 商業垂直農場裡一排排相同的栽培盤高架，上方由一列列紫色 LED 打光。
